ModMetaData.name: Default White Lights
ModMetaData.author: Cruesoe
ModMetaData.description:
Electric lights default to white instead of orange. Optionally set a color per room type; newly built lights use that room's color.
Use Mod options to change the global default, enable room colors, and apply the current colors to lights already on the map.
The in-game color picker and Ideology darklight toggle still work.
